for band in range(1, data.count+1):
    datanp = data.read(band)
    plt.subplot(4,2,band)
    plt.imshow(datanp, cmap="gray", vmin=0, vmax=0.5)
    plt.title(f"Band {band_names[band-1]}")
    plt.colorbar(label="Reflectance", shrink=0.5)

plt.tight_layout()

In [151]:
with rasterio.open("Downloads/Reprojected_City.tif", "w", **profile) as dst:
    for i in range(1, src.count+1):
        reproject(
            source=rasterio.band(src, i),
            destination=rasterio.band(dst, i),
            src_transform=src.transform,
            src_crs=src.crs,
            dst_transform=transform,
            dst_crs=dst_crs,
            resampling=Resampling.nearest
        )
In [153]:
with rasterio.open("Downloads/Reprojected_City_.tif", "w", **profile) as dst:
    for i in range(1, src.count+1):
        reproject(
            source=rasterio.band(src, i),
            destination=rasterio.band(dst, i),
            src_transform=src.transform,
            src_crs=src.crs,
            dst_transform=transform,
            dst_crs=dst_crs,
            resampling=Resampling.nearest,
            dst_nodata=np.nan
        )
